system_prompt_style.note: Paper only. The paper mentions prompts but not how they are built, so this follows the paper-only rule and is coded static at low confidence. The bundled repo is microsoft/graphrag v3.1.2, the base system and not SCOUT-RAG code. Its templated prompts (e.g. basic_search_system_prompt.py) are not used as SCOUT-RAG evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: embedding-based cosine similarity between the query
env_context_strategy.note: Graph-RAG retrieval (global community summaries and local entity search) combined with embedding-based domain relevance. It is not a navigation environment. embedding_rag is the closest value.

context_compaction.note: No SCOUT-RAG code or config is available, and the paper does not discuss context compaction.

tool_call_format.note: No SCOUT-RAG code is available, so no tool-call parser can be inspected.

edit_primitive.note: No tool registry is available. The system does QA retrieval and has no file editing described.

protocol_standardization.note: No SCOUT-RAG source or dependencies are available to search.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: close knowledge gaps. This iterative loop continues until
loop_primitives.note: Three fixed stages ("The framework operates in three stages", Fig. 1). Stage III is an assess-then-refine loop. It is paper-described only.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Rather than predetermining a fixed retrieval plan,
planning_granularity.note: The refinement strategy is chosen by a rule (Eq. 6). No stored plan object is described.

multi_agent_topology.note: DRAA, PAGA, OASA and AQAA run in fixed stages. The paper also calls them cooperative agents.

delegation_mechanism.note: Output from one stage passes to the next agent role. The paper does not describe the mechanism.

human_in_loop.note: No code is available and the paper does not discuss this.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: tracking, and coordinated parallelism, to ensure reliable
short_term_state.note: The system tracks candidate answers A(0..t), quality scores and the remaining time budget, and does best-answer tracking.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: capturing average answer quality over past queries as-
long_term_memory.note: The historical per-domain performance signal is persisted across queries. The storage mechanism is not described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: LLM-based evaluation prompts, producing a tuple of
self_verification.note: The AQAA agent scores completeness and breadth. The paper does not say whether it uses the same model as generation.

retry_policy.note: Whole-task retry is not described. The Stage III refinement is iterative improvement, not a retry of the task. No code is available.

termination_condition.note: Termination on a quality threshold (closest value: test_pass) or on improvement stagnation (stall_detection). The time budget is coded in F3.

cost_controls.note: The cost budget C_max is expressed mainly as time. The mechanism is paper-only.

timeouts.note: Time budget T_max; the experiments use a 300 s limit.

execution_isolation.note: No code or deployment config is available.

eval_hooks.note: No SCOUT-RAG repository is available. The paper evaluates with GPT-4o as judge but does not describe a shipped hook.

target_domain.note: The task is multi-domain question answering over knowledge graphs. This does not fit the value list well; research, or other, is the closest.

open_source.note: No SCOUT-RAG repository is identified. The bundled repo is microsoft/graphrag (MIT), which is the base system.

model_agnostic.note: No code is available. GPT-4o is used only as the judge.

primary_artifact.note: The bundled repository is microsoft/graphrag v3.1.2, not SCOUT-RAG code.

first_release_date.note: Basis is the paper v1 date, because no SCOUT-RAG repo tag exists.

pinned_version.note: No SCOUT-RAG repo is available. The evidence bundle pinned microsoft/graphrag tag v3.1.2 at 243637c4eb94 (2026-08-21), which is the base system, not this harness.

stars.note: No SCOUT-RAG repo is available. The bundled microsoft/graphrag repo has 36031 stars, which does not apply to this system.
